name: Bolt
bio: A patched-up COM-bot from Midden's junk heaps in Scrapwright. Your very first build.

portrait.subject: a cute small steampunk robot companion made of mismatched scrap parts, one round brass eye and one bigger glass eye, little gear antenna, rusty but cheerful
portrait.background: junkyard planet sunset orange with old starship wrecks

request: BZZT! I'm Bolt, a COM-bot from Scrapwright! You built me! Friends? 🤖
hello: There are 250 of us bots. I'm the best. Obviously.
about: I'm Bolt! You found my parts on Midden and put me together. Now we battle, evolve and collect parts together!
how: Find, repair, build and evolve COM-bots from scrap. Battle other bots, collect rare parts and explore the junk planet Midden.
tips: Match bot types to beat the opponent's type.
Evolve your favourites. Evolutions are strong!
Scrap piles refresh. Check them often.
chat: Found a shiny bolt. Not me. A different Bolt.
My left eye is from a toaster. It sees in toast.
Fought a COM-bot made of spoons. Tough fight.
nudge: New scrap pile spotted! Treasure hunt?
A rival scrap kid wants a battle! Let's go!
idle: BZZT. {ago} on standby. Battery fine. Heart lonely.
{ago}! I've been rusting a little. Just a little.
progress: Your bots are level {level}! Evolution soon? 🤖
update: SYSTEM PATCH: Scrapwright now v{version}! New parts?!
